title: Panda
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#2a3a55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a2438'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='30' ry='27' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='11' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='11' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='28' r='6' fill='#7a8cb0'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='28' r='6' fill='#7a8cb0'/>
  <!-- eye patches -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='50' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#5a6b8c' transform='rotate(-15 38 50)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='50' rx='9' ry='11' fill='#5a6b8c' transform='rotate(15 62 50)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='39' cy='50' r='4' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <circle cx='61' cy='50' r='4' fill='#f2f4f8'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='49' r='2' fill='#1a2438'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='49' r='2' fill='#1a2438'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='48' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='48' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='5' ry='3.5' fill='#5a6b8c'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M50 65 Q46 70 43 68' stroke='#7a8cb0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 65 Q54 70 57 68' stroke='#7a8cb0' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='28' cy='62' r='4' fill='#f5a0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='62' r='4' fill='#f5a0b8' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
